title: foxshot
description: This mod allows you to upload your screenshots to simple file hosters. Either manually or automatically.
body:
foxshot allows you to upload your screenshots to file hosters. 

Either manually or automatically.

Auto-uploading is disabled by default.

By default foxshot uses catbox, which needs a userhash to be able to upload which can be acquired by signing up to catbox.moe

Supported services:
- catbox.moe
- 0x0.st (NULLPOINTER)*
- more to come

Note: if you want to add your own, either contribute to the project or make a mod that extends CustomUploadHandler with your own request builder. 

*0x0.st is unavailable.
